Name: Rajesh Nair
Bio:
Dr Rajesh Nair is a Founder of Plaksha University. He is one of the Co-founders of Indegene, and the President of the company. His work includes developing new strategic initiatives, especially as they relate to the company's solutions in RWD-driven R&D for the life sciences.

He comes with 24 years of experience in the technology-led healthcare solutions provider sector. Dr Nair headed the bio-tech division of the Sarabhai Group before co-founding Indegene. He earned his MBBS from GMC Thiruvananthapuram, India (1993) and is also a physician by training. Post that, he pursued an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad. During his time at IIM Ahmedabad, he was also a member of the Entrepreneurship Club and the IIM Ahmedabad Quiz Club.
Education: MBBS, Medicine, Medical College Trivandrum | MBA, IIM Ahmedabad
